review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer – Bluestaq Australia
review_candidates.description: Senior Systems Engineer – Bluestaq Australia Location - Canberra | On-site, with occasional remote flexibility subject to project requirements Role Type - Full-Time or Contract Our purpose is to deliver mission critical technology solutions tailored for the Australian defence, government and national security sectors. We specialise in high security data systems, designed to meet Australia's evolving strategic and operational demands. If you are ready to turn your expertise into real world results, welcome to Bluestaq Australia. This is your opportunity to join a young but fast growing company in its formative years in Australia, building on our successful foundations in the United States. About the Role The Senior Systems Engineer will lead the design, deployment and maintenance of secure data management platform in defence environments. This role encompasses full system lifecycle management, user support and technical leadership to ensure secure, compliant and high performing IT operations in defence aligned environments. Reporting to the Bluestaq Australia leadership team, you will: Architect and maintain a resilient Linux server environment, with demonstrated expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, identity and access management (IAM) and network configurations Configure and manage firewalls, routers and switches, including VLANs, DNS and IAM integration Lead ongoing system maintenance, software installation, configuration, integrated testing and troubleshooting Assist end users by addressing technical inquiries and resolving access or configuration issues Oversee patch management, configuration compliance, change control and vulnerability mitigation Implement system hardening in alignment with the ASD Essential Eight, Australian ISM and ACSC guidelines, and conduct regular audits Liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders; provide technical updates and recommendations to leadership Maintain production Kubernetes (K8s) clusters across multiple on-premises environments, encompassing tasks such as deployment, scaling, monitoring (using tools like Prometheus/Grafana), and troubleshooting for containerised applications. Develop and maintain automation and scripting solutions (Ansible, Bash, PowerShell, Python) to streamline system operations, configuration management and security compliance Provide technical mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence Use modern AI tools with judgment: integrating them into workflows where they're impactful, reviewing their outputs, and handling proprietary or sensitive data responsibly. About You We're looking for an experienced IT professional passionate about secure systems in defence contexts. You'll thrive here if you enjoy technical leadership, problem solving, and contributing to meaningful missions. Essential Skills and Experience: 8–10+ years of relevant experience in systems engineering or IT infrastructure, ideally in defence or government environments Proven expertise in Active Directory and Linux system administration Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills Willingness to travel within Australia to customer and partner locations, including secure government or defence sites, and occasional travel to Bluestaq offices in the United States for collaboration or project work. You must also be an Australian citizen, currently holding and able to maintain Australian Government NV2 security clearance. Highly Regarded Skills and Experience: Relevant qualifications or equivalent hands-on experience Networking experience (e.g., CCNA/CCNP level or practical equivalents in firewalls, routing, VLANs) Experience with Kubernetes in on-premises environments Proficiency in scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) Leadership or mentoring in technical teams (or demonstrated potential to grow into this) Familiarity with ASD Essential Eight or defence compliance Your Benefits $160,000 – $200,000 per annum + superannuation + annual performance bonus Private health cover allowance Health/wellness allowance Professional subscription Salary sacrifice and salary packaging options Additional 1 week of annual leave per year = 5 weeks per year Other leave in accordance with the National Employment Standards and state long service leave legislation Salary Range (CO): $160,000 USD - $200,000 USD Join the Mission If you're ready to engineer secure, sovereign capable technology, Bluestaq Australia offers you the chance to lead and innovate at the forefront of national defence and critical infrastructure. Together, we’ll tackle high stakes challenges, protect Australia's most vital data and build what’s next, securely, on-premises and at scale. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ and culturally diverse candidates.

review_candidates.description: Date: June 2026 Position: Senior SMS Network Operations Engineer – Remote Experience Level: Medium Work Type: Night Shift - Remote (Asia Pacific Countries PHT - GMT+8) Region: Europe Salary: Competitive USD salary aligned with senior SMS NOC profiles in the Philippines - up to 42K/year About Us: For our partner, a B2B telecom carrier operating across Europe, providing A2P SMS services, DID/inbound number hosting, MO and MT routing to enterprise clients including major hyperscalers and BPO we are hiring their first Senior SMS Network Operations Engineer based in the Asia Pacific time zone (UTC+5:30 to UTC+9)to provide 24/7 expert coverage of our SMS network during European night time hours. This is a deeply hands-on SMS role. You eat SMPP for breakfast. You can spot a misconfigured bind from a delivery report. You know what makes A2P traffic flow or fail. What You’ll Do: You will be the company’s SMS operations engineer during European night time, owning the network end-to-end: Monitor A2P SMS infrastructure in real time across multiple European countries: delivery rates, latency, throughput, bind health Troubleshoot MO and MT traffic issues: misrouting, undelivered messages, encoding problems, sender ID issues, MNP lookup failures Investigate inbound number (DID/LVN) issues across hosted ranges, including range allocation, porting and carrier-level filtering Read and analyse SMPP traces, PCAPs and aggregator logs to identify root causes Be the first responder on incidents paged by our enterprise customers, with a 15-minute response commitment on critical (Sev 1 / Sev 2) issues Open and manage trouble tickets, classify incident severity, drive resolution with our suppliers Produce post-incident reports with root cause analysis, traffic impact breakdown, fix and preventive measures Contribute to NOC runbooks, monitoring rules and operational documentation Working Hours: Manila time: 06:00 to 14:00, Monday to Friday, with a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team as it grows. You work during your daytime, when you are at your sharpest. What We Require: 5+ years in SMS network operations at a carrier, aggregator, CPaaS or messaging hub Deep hands-on SMPP 3.4 expertise: binds (transceiver, transmitter, receiver), submit_sm and deliver_sm flows, error codes, throughput optimisation, troubleshooting connection drops and message loss Strong experience with A2P SMS at scale: routing, MCC/MNC selection, MNP lookups, throughput shaping, carrier filtering, delivery reports Expertise on MO traffic: inbound message handling, sender ID preservation, carrier handover, latency tuning Hands-on experience operating DID / inbound number ranges: provisioning, porting, hosted vs owned numbers, carrier-level configuration Comfortable reading and analysing SMPP traces, PCAPs, aggregator and SMSC logs Familiar with trouble ticketing (TT) workflows, severity classification, post-mortem reporting, NOC operating discipline Working knowledge of character encodings (GSM 3.38, UCS-2, ASCII, Windows-1252), concatenated messages, WAP Push, binary SMS Fluent written and spoken English (you will interact with enterprise customers and a multinational team) Reliable home internet with backup connection for 24/7 commitments Strong Plus: Hands-on experience with Alaris SMS infrastructure (in-Memory Profiler, SMS Routing, Number Portability Database, Traffic Wizard) Experience interfacing with hyperscaler customers (Google, Microsoft, Meta, AWS) on SMS use cases such as OTP and 2FA flows Familiarity with European telecom regulators (ARCEP, Ofcom) and their A2P rules Nice To Have: Voice knowledge: basic understanding of SIP, voice termination, DID for voice Exposure to ISO 27001 or ISO 27701 operational requirements What We Offer: Competitive USD salary aligned with senior SMS NOC profiles in the Philippines - up to 42K/year 100% remote, work from home Modern stack and infrastructure, including Alaris and direct connections to European rangeowners Direct collaboration with the Head of SMS Network and the founder Real impact: you will be the foundation of our enterprise customer operations and the first dedicated SMS expert in company’s NOC Ready to seize this opportunity? review_candidates.title: Senior High Performance Computing Engineer - Classified Environment
review_candidates.description: Requisition Id 16923 Overview: The Field Intelligence Operations Division invites candidates to apply to join the team as a Senior High Performance Computing (HPC) Engineer for Classified Computing to lead the design, implementation, and management of HPC systems within a classified environment. We are looking for candidates with extensive experience in HPC architecture, cluster management, and parallel computing, with a proven ability to work within highly secure and regulated environments. This role involves close collaboration with security teams, scientists, and IT leadership to ensure that the HPC infrastructure meets the stringent performance, security, and compliance requirements necessary for classified work. As part of our team, you will be joining a vibrant group of professionals eager to provide premier customer service to ensure people and information technology remain secure. The team is collaborative and strives to ensure security practices and procedures are understood, implemented, and enforced. All team members deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success. As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation. Major Duties/Responsibilities: HPC System Design and Architecture: Lead the design and deployment of HPC systems, ensuring they meet the computational needs and security requirements of a classified environment. Create and maintain detailed documentation of HPC architectures, configurations, and operational procedures. Cluster Management and Optimization: Oversee the installation, configuration, and management of HPC clusters, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and reliability. Implement and manage job scheduling, resource allocation, and load balancing to maximize the efficiency of HPC resources. Security and Compliance: Ensure all HPC systems comply with security policies and regulatory requirements, implementing necessary controls and conducting regular audits. Collaborate with the security team to address vulnerabilities and ensure the protection of sensitive data within the HPC environment. Performance Tuning and Troubleshooting: Monitor and optimize the performance of HPC systems, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies. Identify and resolve complex issues, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption to critical operations. Collaboration and Leadership: Lead HPC-related projects, from initial planning and design through to implementation and operational support. Collaborate with scientists, researchers, and others to ensure that the HPC environment meets their computational needs. Mentor and support junior HPC engineers, sharing expertise and best practices. Continuous Improvement and Innovation: Research and remain informed of the latest advancements in HPC technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and enhancement of the HPC infrastructure. Propose and implement improvements to existing systems and processes to support the evolving needs of the organization. Basic Qualifications: BS in computer science, engineering, or a related field anda minimum eight (8) years of relevant experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Eight (8)years of experience in HPC engineering, with a focus on cluster management, parallel computing, and performance optimization. Demonstrated experience working in classified environments, including a thorough understanding of security policies, compliance frameworks, and associated standard processes (e.g., NIST, DISA STIGs). HPC systems architecture experience, including cluster management tools (e.g., SLURM, PBS, Moab). Linux system administration skills, with experience in scripting and automation using tools such as Bash, Python, or Ansible. Experience with performance tuning and benchmarking tools for HPC environments (e.g., Ganglia, Grafana, or similar). Experience with parallel programming frameworks (e.g., MPI, OpenMP, CUDA) and high-performance interconnects (e.g., InfiniBand). Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with advanced storage solutions and parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, GPFS, or BeeGFS). Professional certifications (e.g., Certified HPC Professional, Linux+, or Security+) Excellent leadership and project management abilities. Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-collaborative teams. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, high-security environment. Proactive mentality with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement in the rapidly evolving HPC field. Special Requirements: Visa sponsorship: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Physical Requirements: Work may involve various physical requirements and working conditions. Security, Credentialing, and Eligibilty Requirements: Q clearance with SCI: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program. In addition, due the SCI, you may also be subject to random polygraph testing. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws. About ORNL: As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation. ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience. Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts. This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired. We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment. If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov. ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

review_candidates.description: In this role, you will be providing L2 support for production applications within Data Delivery, Controls & Analytics, driving operational excellence and service reliability across our diverse technology landscape. You will collaborate with development teams to resolve issues, ensuring smooth operation and high availability of systems in a production environment. You will effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations. The Integrated Financial Crime (IFC) portfolio is a multi-faceted Financial Crime programme of change delivered via over 20 programmes to create a holistic, risk-based and effective Financial Crime environment, strengthen robustness and enhance automation of Financial Crime processes, develop and strengthen our skills and capabilities across all lines of defence and empower our partners, colleagues and customers to identify and prevent Financial Crime by raising awareness of the risks. To be successful as a Senior Service Engineer, you should have experience with: Relational Databases, particularly MSSQL/ Oracle (with exposure to writing queries, tuning concepts, stored procedures) and Unix Shell/ Python script. Cloud technologies, AWS, OpenShift/APIs. Monitoring & Observability tools - ITRS Geneos, AppDynamics and scheduling Tools – TWS and/or Autosys. Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include Experience/ knowledge of CI-CD pipeline – Gitlab automation, Hadoop, GenAI. Prior experience/ knowledge of Banking domain, Financial Crime/ AML. Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and conflict resolution skills to interact with customers effectively. You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, communication skills and interaction with a diverse range of stakeholders, as well as job-specific technical skills . This role is based out Glasgow. Purpose of the role To effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations. Accountabilities Provision of technical support for the service management function to resolve more complex issues for a specific client of group of clients. Develop the support model and service offering to improve the service to customers and stakeholders. Execution of preventative maintenance tasks on hardware and software and utilisation of monitoring tools/metrics to identify, prevent and address potential issues and ensure optimal performance. Maintenance of a knowledge base containing detailed documentation of resolved cases for future reference, self-service opportunities and knowledge sharing. Analysis of system logs, error messages and user reports to identify the root causes of hardware, software and network issues, and providing a resolution to these issues by fixing or replacing faulty hardware components, reinstalling software, or applying configuration changes. Automation, monitoring enhancements, capacity management, resiliency, business continuity management, front office specific support and stakeholder management. Identification and remediation or raising, through appropriate process, of potential service impacting risks and issues. Proactively assess support activities implementing automations where appropriate to maintain stability and drive efficiency. Actively tune monitoring tools, thresholds, and alerting to ensure issues are known when they occur. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively. Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more. In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible. Position Overview: This role is responsible for defining, designing, and governing cloud architecture standards across the organization to ensure scalable, secure, resilient and cost-effective solutions. This role provides technical leadership across infrastructure, networking, identity, and security. This role will partner closely with Infrastructure Engineering to establish cloud best practices, and translate business requirements into robust, scalable solutions. Responsibilities Translate business and application requirements into end-to-end Azure solution across compute, networking, storage, identity, and security. Evaluate project architectures for adherence to cloud best practices, security posture, and cost efficiency. Evaluate and recommend Azure services, tools, and third-party integrations to meet evolving organizational needs Provide architectural oversight for server virtualization platforms, enterprise monitoring and observability, network, security and identity management. Champion automation across provisioning, configuration management and operational tasks. Define and drive DevOps practices and culture across engineering teams. Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions Monitor and optimize cloud spending, providing recommendations to maximize cost efficiency without compromising security and reliability. Architect and govern enterprise AVD environments, including host pool design, image management, and session host scaling strategies Apply expertise across core system design domains including CDN, distributed caching, message bus, API gateway, load balancing and event-driven architecture. Define standards for monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery and cost management Act as a technical authority and mentor for Infrastructure and Cloud Engineering teams. Communicate architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements: 5-8 years of professional experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or related disciplines Deep hands-on experience designing and implementing Azure architecture and landing zones. Strong understanding of Azure IaaS and PaaS services (Compute, Networking, Storage, Security, etc.). Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform or Bicep. Hands-on experience authoring production Infrastructure as Code focused on modularity and code reusable pattern. Proven track record designing and operating CI/CD pipeline at scale using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, security architecture, and identity management in cloud environments. Strong system design background with demonstrated ability to provide solutions spanning distributed systems concepts such as CDN, caching strategies, message bus, API gateways, and load balancing. Excellent verbal and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong documentation, decision making, and presentation skills. Strategic thinking with strong problem-solving abilities. Preferred: Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority. Highly collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Proficiency with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Go, or Bash Pay Details: The base compensation range for this position is $130,000 - $150,000. This range reflects Acrisure's good faith estimate at the time of this posting. new_matches.title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
new_matches.location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
new_matches.description: Jouw rol als Microsoft 365 Engineer bij Quality Ben jij een ervaren Microsoft 365 Engineer die energie krijgt van complexe cloud omgevingen en impact wil maken bij uiteenlopende organisaties? Dan is Quality op zoek naar jou. Hoe ga jij onze opdrachtgevers helpen om hun cloudprestaties te optimaliseren? Als Microsoft 365 Engineer werk je aan het inrichten, beheren en optimaliseren van moderne werkplekomgevingen. Je helpt organisaties om veilig en efficiënt samen te werken, met een sterke focus op identity, security en compliance. Je bent betrokken bij zowel migraties als de doorontwikkeling van Microsoft 365-omgevingen. Afhankelijk van je senioriteit ligt je focus op de technische uitvoering of juist op ontwerp, advisering en regie. Een kijkje in jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden Je draagt bij aan het succes van opdrachtgevers door het: Beheren, optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen van Microsoft 365-omgevingen Migreren van omgevingen naar Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune) Inrichten en beheren van identity- en accessoplossingen binnen Entra ID Implementeren van Conditional Access, Identity Governance en Zero Trust-principes Beheren van endpoints en devices met Microsoft Intune Implementeren van security- en compliance-oplossingen (Microsoft Defender, Purview, DLP, MFA) Inrichten en beheren van virtuele werkplekken (Azure Virtual Desktop en/of Windows 365) Automatiseren van beheer en configuraties met PowerShell Werken binnen Agile/DevOps-teams en bijdragen aan gestandaardiseerde werkwijzen Je legt technische keuzes en configuraties vast in documentatie en draagt bij aan de verdere standaardisatie van Microsoft 365-omgevingen. Waarom Quality jouw volgende stap is Quality is een gespecialiseerde kennisorganisatie waar vakmanschap centraal staat. We stellen hoge eisen aan kwaliteit maar hebben ook oog voor de mens achter onze professional. Cloud is een breed en dynamisch vakgebied, met ruimte voor verschillende specialisaties. Welke expertise je ook meebrengt: jouw persoonlijke kwaliteiten en bijdrage aan het team vinden wij minstens zo belangrijk als je technische kennis. Wat je meebrengt Jij bent een gedreven Microsoft 365 Engineer die houdt van uitdaging en verantwoordelijkheid. Je weet hoe je complexe cloud vraagstukken oplost en bent klaar voor de volgende stap. Verder beschik je over: Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Microsoft 365 en andere cloudproviders of een combinatie hiervan Brede kennis van Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint en Intune Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft Defender, Purview en moderne securityconcepten (zoals Zero Trust) Je hebt ervaring met Azure Virtual Desktop en/of Windows 365, automatisering via PowerShell en Affiniteit met security en moderne werkplekomgevingen Je hebt ruime ervaring met het beheren, configureren en implementeren van Microsoft 365-oplossingen, en in staat om zelfstandig onderdelen op te pakken Je werkt graag Agile en bent bekend met Scrum, Kanban en DevOps-methodieken Je automatiseert processen met scripting zoals PowerShell, Bicep of Terraform Minimaal twee relevante Microsoft-certificeringen, zoals MD-102, MS-102, MS-721, SC-300, SC-200, AZ-140 of AZ-104 Wat wij jou bieden Je krijgt een vast contract voor minimaal 36 uur per week. Omdat we vertrouwen hebben in jouw expertise als Microsoft 365 Engineer, bieden we je bij een fulltime dienstverband onderstaande aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een goed salaris, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring tussen de € 4.000 en € 6.000. Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarde zoals een premievrije pensioenregeling. Hiermee houd je netto meer over! 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid tot het bijkopen. Voldoende opleidings- en studiemogelijkheden met een jaarlijks studiebudget van €3500,- en 5 studiedagen. Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, Apple MacBook of Microsoft Surface en een iPhone. Een sportschool bij ons op kantoor en daarnaast nog een bedrijfsfitness-regeling, mocht je toch lekker dicht bij huis willen sporten. Vrijdagmiddag borrels, bedrijfsuitjes, maandelijkse BBQ en gezellige collega’s. Goede ontwikkeling- en doorgroeimogelijkheden maar we helpen ook jouw persoonlijke leerpad te bewandelen. Ontdek hoe het is om bij Quality te werken Wil je meer weten over Quality? Klik dan hier en lees over wat Quality doet, wat de essentie is van de organisatie en hoe Quality jou faciliteert in jouw groei en ontwikkeling. Bij Quality sta jij centraal Wij stimuleren een steile leercurve waarin jij de regie hebt over je eigen carrière. Ambieer je een rol in consultancy of architecture? Of gaat je hart sneller kloppen van specialisaties als networking, cloud of automation? Jij bepaalt zelf jouw koers en Quality faciliteert in jouw ambities. Dit doen wij met een persoonlijke roadmap, gericht op de ontwikkeling van zowel jouw technische vaardigheden als je persoonlijke kwaliteiten. Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan nu op deze vacature! Wil jij Team Quality versterken? Of heb je nog vragen? Mail naar max.trapman@quality.nl of bel: 06-38 98 13 80

new_matches.title: Houston - Senior Collaboration Engineer
new_matches.description: About Us At Winston Taylor, we set the standard, together. Winston Taylor is a transatlantic law firm built for the businesses, people, and markets driving capital and innovation. Here, you're in the room. In the action. Sleeves rolled up. You'll work with leading clients. Disruptors. Fast-growth companies. And help them to stay one step ahead of the moment and make critical decisions that shape their future. We're present in the U.S., U.K., Europe, Latin America, and the Middle East, combining the scale and speed that clients demand. You'll be trusted with real responsibility from the outset and build experience through hands-on work. We take your progression personally. We provide the platform. You shape the work around your goals and aspirations. Step into the moments that matter. Join Winston Taylor. Position Summary The Senior Collaboration Engineer owns the performance, reliability, and operational effectiveness of the Firm’s Microsoft 365 collaboration services. This role leads service improvements, manages complex operational activities, and drives issue resolution to ensure a stable, secure, and high-performing collaboration platform. The position works closely with the Network Operations Center, Information Risk, and Identity teams to lead operational alignment and continuously improve service quality. Position Responsibilities Own the health, performance, and reliability of Microsoft 365 collaboration services. Manage and improve mail flow security controls to ensure effective and stable operations. Lead root cause analysis and drive implementation of sustainable remediation solutions. Manage and drive Microsoft 365 service changes end-to-end, including planning, coordination, and execution. Lead collaboration with the Network Operations Center to reduce recurring issues and improve service quality. Partner with Information Risk, Identity, and Information Governance teams to ensure secure and compliant operations. Drive evaluation and controlled adoption of new features and capabilities in alignment with established standards. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex issues and lead resolution efforts. Improve documentation standards, operational processes, and service quality practices. Mentor team members and provide technical guidance across daily operations. Experience, Skills And Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating foundational technical expertise and the ability to deliver high-quality work product required . 7+ years of experience administering Microsoft 365 collaboration services, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and related security and compliance capabilities, with demonstrated advanced functional expertise required . Hands-on experience managing email flow security, including spam filtering, transport controls, and related mail hygiene practices, with strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate , high-quality results required . Experience supporting Microsoft 365 service changes, resolving complex technical issues with sound judgment, and producing clear operational documentation and support procedures required . Experience using common M365 automation solutions (PowerShell, Power Platform, Azure Automation) to improve the efficiency & consistency of administrative and operational tasks required . Experience utilizing a data-driven approach and “ shift-left” principles to optimize the M365 end-user experience and improve the efficiency & effectiveness of the technical support process preferred. Experience designing & building Power BI dashboards, ETL pipelines, and data storage solutions in Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric preferred. Demonstrated ability to manage responsibilities independently, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain accountability for timely and high-quality outcomes required . Experience working with Information Risk, Identity, and Information Governance teams to support secure and effective Microsoft 365 operations through strong collaboration and shared problem solving desired. Experience supporting data retention, compliance, or governance capabilities within Microsoft 365, including Purview, with awareness of operational risk and disciplined execution desired. Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot implementation, adoption, or governance for business use cases, with openness to innovation and evolving technology trends desired. Strong ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, adapt messaging to varied audiences, and work effectively with stakeholders across technical and business teams desired. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, accept feedback, and contribute as a collaborative team member while maintaining accountability for results desired. Functional Expertise – Demonstrates advanced subject matter expertise in Microsoft 365 collaboration services, including Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and SharePoint Online, and applies that knowledge to deliver high-quality work product across complex operational scenarios. Embraces technology and innovation opportunities, stays current with platform capabilities and industry trends, and leverages a broad understanding of Information Technology environments, services, and operational dependencies to contribute meaningfully to projects and service improvements. Operational Excellence – Optimizes processes, resources, and priorities to deliver accurate, timely, and high-quality results, often with limited supervision. Demonstrates disciplined execution, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement while managing multiple priorities efficiently, meeting deadlines, and maintaining a customer-focused mindset. Maintains flexibility in support of operational needs, including availability after hours as required. Problem Solving & Judgment – Uses strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills to identify and resolve issues within area of expertise. Applies sound judgment to assess information, propose timely and actionable solutions, and implement sustainable improvements, at times with limited supervision based on complexity, while escalating as necessary to mitigate risk. Communication & Collaboration – Communicates clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing, adapting messages for technical and non-technical audiences and presenting concepts in a way stakeholders at all levels can understand. Builds positive relationships, works effectively both independently and collaboratively, engages in active listening, considers diverse perspectives, and resolves conflicts constructively to support inclusive teamwork and team success. Ownership & Accountability – Demonstrates ownership of responsibilities across the full job scope and is accountable for results. Independently manages workload, adapts to changing priorities, and maintains quality standards while remaining receptive to feedback and course-correcting when needed. Shows initiative to learn continuously, teach others, and mentor teammates and partners to strengthen overall team capability and effectiveness. Benefits Winston offers comprehensive benefits that provide a full spectrum of coverage and support for our full-time employees and their families. Additional information about benefits and rewards can be found here . SALARY Illinois applicants only: The target annual salary range for this role is currently $128,000-$167,000 based on a regular, full-time schedule. The amount of compensation offered will be determined by several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications, market data and internal equity. Total compensation includes a comprehensive healthcare benefits package, yearly retirement contribution, and may include an annual discretionary merit bonus. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

Support platform observability through logging, metrics, and tracing to enable rapid troubleshooting and insights. CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines for data platform deployments. Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows, Notebooks, Clusters, MLflow. Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs/Kafka, Key Vault, Functions, Synapse. AI Foundry, Networking, APIM Knowledge, Azure App Service, App Service Plan Deployment and Configuration, Integration with Azure bot Services MS Fabric: Tenant Management, Workspace Private Links, Deployment, Capacity Management, Workspace Management, One Lake, Data Mirroring, Power BI AI Foundry : Model management, Hosted Agents Deployment and Management , Project Configuration (Connections and Governance ) and lifecycle management. ACENSI, société de conseil en transformation digitale, accompagne des entreprises de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que la banque, l'assurance, l'énergie ou les télécoms. Avec plus de 2 200 talents en France et à l'international (Canada, Belgique, Île Maurice, Portugal, Roumanie...), ACENSI conçoit et déploie des solutions numériques qui transforment durablement les organisations depuis 2003. Dans le cadre du renforcement d'une équipe Infrastructure intervenant sur un système d'information critique, nous recherchons un Expert Systèmes Linux H/F afin d'accompagner les projets de sécurisation, d'industrialisation et d'optimisation des plateformes techniques. Missions Principales Architecture & Sécurité Concevoir des souches Linux durcies à partir des spécifications métier et des exigences de cybersécurité. Mettre en oeuvre les recommandations et bonnes pratiques de sécurité. Intégrer les produits et applications métiers au sein des environnements techniques. Participer aux projets de remédiation des vulnérabilités et d'optimisation des infrastructures. Documenter les bonnes pratiques liées à la sécurité, à la résilience et aux performances. Administration & Exploitation Administrer les environnements Linux (RHEL / CentOS). Assurer la gestion des mises à jour, correctifs et packages. Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la résilience des plateformes. Assurer le support de niveau 3 et la résolution des incidents complexes. Participer à la mise en place des pratiques d'exploitation dans une démarche d'amélioration continue. Automatisation & Industrialisation Automatiser les opérations d'administration avec Ansible. Développer et maintenir les infrastructures en Infrastructure as Code avec Terraform. Gérer les scripts, configurations et versions dans GitLab. Mettre en place des outils d'automatisation, d'orchestration et d'industrialisation des processus. Optimiser les tâches récurrentes et contribuer aux pratiques DevOps. Qualité & Documentation Définir et mettre en oeuvre les tests et procédures de validation des solutions. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique (HLD, LLD, procédures d'exploitation, inventaires, dossiers techniques). Accompagner et former les équipes de production sur les nouveaux projets et outils. Assurer un reporting régulier de l'activité et de l'avancement des travaux. Profil Recherché Formation Bac +5 en informatique ou équivalent. Au moins 7 ans d'expérience sur Linux (RHEL/CentOS), Ansible et Terraform. Expérience dans des environnements à fortes contraintes de cybersécurité. Connaissances DevOps (Git, GitLab, CI/CD) et automatisation. Rigueur, autonomie et esprit d'analyse. Les compétences VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Python ou SCADA sont un plus.

What You’ll Do: You will be the company’s SMS operations engineer during European night time, owning the network end-to-end: Monitor A2P SMS infrastructure in real time across multiple European countries: delivery rates, latency, throughput, bind health Troubleshoot MO and MT traffic issues: misrouting, undelivered messages, encoding problems, sender ID issues, MNP lookup failures Investigate inbound number (DID/LVN) issues across hosted ranges, including range allocation, porting and carrier-level filtering Read and analyse SMPP traces, PCAPs and aggregator logs to identify root causes Be the first responder on incidents paged by our enterprise customers, with a 15-minute response commitment on critical (Sev 1 / Sev 2) issues Open and manage trouble tickets, classify incident severity, drive resolution with our suppliers Produce post-incident reports with root cause analysis, traffic impact breakdown, fix and preventive measures Contribute to NOC runbooks, monitoring rules and operational documentation Working Hours: Manila time: 06:00 to 14:00, Monday to Friday, with a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team as it grows. You work during your daytime, when you are at your sharpest. What We Require: 5+ years in SMS network operations at a carrier, aggregator, CPaaS or messaging hub Deep hands-on SMPP 3.4 expertise: binds (transceiver, transmitter, receiver), submit_sm and deliver_sm flows, error codes, throughput optimisation, troubleshooting connection drops and message loss Strong experience with A2P SMS at scale: routing, MCC/MNC selection, MNP lookups, throughput shaping, carrier filtering, delivery reports Expertise on MO traffic: inbound message handling, sender ID preservation, carrier handover, latency tuning Hands-on experience operating DID / inbound number ranges: provisioning, porting, hosted vs owned numbers, carrier-level configuration Comfortable reading and analysing SMPP traces, PCAPs, aggregator and SMSC logs Familiar with trouble ticketing (TT) workflows, severity classification, post-mortem reporting, NOC operating discipline Working knowledge of character encodings (GSM 3.38, UCS-2, ASCII, Windows-1252), concatenated messages, WAP Push, binary SMS Fluent written and spoken English (you will interact with enterprise customers and a multinational team) Reliable home internet with backup connection for 24/7 commitments Strong Plus: Hands-on experience with Alaris SMS infrastructure (in-Memory Profiler, SMS Routing, Number Portability Database, Traffic Wizard) Experience interfacing with hyperscaler customers (Google, Microsoft, Meta, AWS) on SMS use cases such as OTP and 2FA flows Familiarity with European telecom regulators (ARCEP, Ofcom) and their A2P rules Nice To Have: Voice knowledge: basic understanding of SIP, voice termination, DID for voice Exposure to ISO 27001 or ISO 27701 operational requirements What We Offer: Competitive USD salary aligned with senior SMS NOC profiles in the Philippines - new_matches.title: Senior High Performance Computing Engineer - Classified Environment
new_matches.description: Requisition Id 16923 Overview: The Field Intelligence Operations Division invites candidates to apply to join the team as a Senior High Performance Computing (HPC) Engineer for Classified Computing to lead the design, implementation, and management of HPC systems within a classified environment. We are looking for candidates with extensive experience in HPC architecture, cluster management, and parallel computing, with a proven ability to work within highly secure and regulated environments. This role involves close collaboration with security teams, scientists, and IT leadership to ensure that the HPC infrastructure meets the stringent performance, security, and compliance requirements necessary for classified work. As part of our team, you will be joining a vibrant group of professionals eager to provide premier customer service to ensure people and information technology remain secure. The team is collaborative and strives to ensure security practices and procedures are understood, implemented, and enforced. All team members deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success. As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation. Major Duties/Responsibilities: HPC System Design and Architecture: Lead the design and deployment of HPC systems, ensuring they meet the computational needs and security requirements of a classified environment. Create and maintain detailed documentation of HPC architectures, configurations, and operational procedures. Cluster Management and Optimization: Oversee the installation, configuration, and management of HPC clusters, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and reliability. Implement and manage job scheduling, resource allocation, and load balancing to maximize the efficiency of HPC resources. Security and Compliance: Ensure all HPC systems comply with security policies and regulatory requirements, implementing necessary controls and conducting regular audits. Collaborate with the security team to address vulnerabilities and ensure the protection of sensitive data within the HPC environment. Performance Tuning and Troubleshooting: Monitor and optimize the performance of HPC systems, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies. Identify and resolve complex issues, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption to critical operations. Collaboration and Leadership: Lead HPC-related projects, from initial planning and design through to implementation and operational support. Collaborate with scientists, researchers, and others to ensure that the HPC environment meets their computational needs. Mentor and support junior HPC engineers, sharing expertise and best practices. Continuous Improvement and Innovation: Research and remain informed of the latest advancements in HPC technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and enhancement of the HPC infrastructure. Propose and implement improvements to existing systems and processes to support the evolving needs of the organization. Basic Qualifications: BS in computer science, engineering, or a related field anda minimum eight (8) years of relevant experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Eight (8)years of experience in HPC engineering, with a focus on cluster management, parallel computing, and performance optimization. Demonstrated experience working in classified environments, including a thorough understanding of security policies, compliance frameworks, and associated standard processes (e.g., NIST, DISA STIGs). HPC systems architecture experience, including cluster management tools (e.g., SLURM, PBS, Moab). Linux system administration skills, with experience in scripting and automation using tools such as Bash, Python, or Ansible. Experience with performance tuning and benchmarking tools for HPC environments (e.g., Ganglia, Grafana, or similar). Experience with parallel programming frameworks (e.g., MPI, OpenMP, CUDA) and high-performance interconnects (e.g., InfiniBand). Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with advanced storage solutions and parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, GPFS, or BeeGFS). Professional certifications (e.g., Certified HPC Professional, Linux+, or Security+) Excellent leadership and project management abilities. Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-collaborative teams. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, high-security environment. Proactive mentality with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement in the rapidly evolving HPC field. Special Requirements: Visa sponsorship: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Physical Requirements: Work may involve various physical requirements and working conditions. Security, Credentialing, and Eligibilty Requirements: Q clearance with SCI: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program. In addition, due the SCI, you may also be subject to random polygraph testing. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws. About ORNL: As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation. ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience. Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts. This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired. We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment. If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov. ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

new_matches.title: Senior Service Engineer
new_matches.description: In this role, you will be providing L2 support for production applications within Data Delivery, Controls & Analytics, driving operational excellence and service reliability across our diverse technology landscape. You will collaborate with development teams to resolve issues, ensuring smooth operation and high availability of systems in a production environment. You will effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations. The Integrated Financial Crime (IFC) portfolio is a multi-faceted Financial Crime programme of change delivered via over 20 programmes to create a holistic, risk-based and effective Financial Crime environment, strengthen robustness and enhance automation of Financial Crime processes, develop and strengthen our skills and capabilities across all lines of defence and empower our partners, colleagues and customers to identify and prevent Financial Crime by raising awareness of the risks. To be successful as a Senior Service Engineer, you should have experience with: Relational Databases, particularly MSSQL/ Oracle (with exposure to writing queries, tuning concepts, stored procedures) and Unix Shell/ Python script. Cloud technologies, AWS, OpenShift/APIs. Monitoring & Observability tools - ITRS Geneos, AppDynamics and scheduling Tools – TWS and/or Autosys. Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include Experience/ knowledge of CI-CD pipeline – Gitlab automation, Hadoop, GenAI. Prior experience/ knowledge of Banking domain, Financial Crime/ AML. Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and conflict resolution skills to interact with customers effectively. You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, communication skills and interaction with a diverse range of stakeholders, as well as job-specific technical skills . This role is based out Glasgow. Purpose of the role To effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations. Accountabilities Provision of technical support for the service management function to resolve more complex issues for a specific client of group of clients. Develop the support model and service offering to improve the service to customers and stakeholders. Execution of preventative maintenance tasks on hardware and software and utilisation of monitoring tools/metrics to identify, prevent and address potential issues and ensure optimal performance. Maintenance of a knowledge base containing detailed documentation of resolved cases for future reference, self-service opportunities and knowledge sharing. Analysis of system logs, error messages and user reports to identify the root causes of hardware, software and network issues, and providing a resolution to these issues by fixing or replacing faulty hardware components, reinstalling software, or applying configuration changes. Automation, monitoring enhancements, capacity management, resiliency, business continuity management, front office specific support and stakeholder management. Identification and remediation or raising, through appropriate process, of potential service impacting risks and issues. Proactively assess support activities implementing automations where appropriate to maintain stability and drive efficiency. Actively tune monitoring tools, thresholds, and alerting to ensure issues are known when they occur. Assistant Vice President Expectations To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively. Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
